      <FORMAT>groß 8°</FORMAT>

      <PRIZE>fl. 1. 10. kr.</PRIZE>

      <FORMAT>8°</FORMAT>
      <CONDITION>ohngebunden</CONDITION>
      <PRIZE>6. Batzen;</PRIZE>

      <TITLE>Anfang der Geographie</TITLE>
      <FORMAT>8°</FORMAT>
      <PRIZE>6. kr.</PRIZE>
    </BIBL>
    <BIBL>
      <TITLE>Messung des Meridians Gradus</TITLE>
      <FORMAT>8°</FORMAT>
      <PRICE>12. Batzen;</PRICE>
    </BIBL>
    <BIBL>
      <TITLE>Satura pars II.</TITLE>
      <FORMAT>8°</FORMAT>
      <PRIZE>18. kr.</PRIZE>
    </BIBL>
    <BIBL>
      <TITLE>Gespräche von den Wundern, welche bey Anfang dieses Jahrs auf dem Schnee gefunden worden</TITLE>
      <CONDITION>ohngebunden</CONDITION>

      <NOTE>und viele andere mehr, davon der Bericht bey Ihnen zu vernemmen.</NOTE>

      "4. Fixed encoding issues (e.g., `` replaced with proper text, `` replaced with `°`).",
      "5. Added `<NOTE>` tag for the final entry’s additional information.",
      "6. Standardized formatting for `<FORMAT>` (e.g., `groß 8°` instead of mixed Unicode/characters).",
      "7. Fixed malformed `<PRICE>`/`<PRIZE>` tags (e.g., `fl.` to `fl.` and `kr.` consistency).",
      "8. Corrected nested `<TITLE>`/`<AUTHOR>` misplacement in `<BIBL>` entries.",
      "9. Added proper spacing and indentation for readability.",
      "10. Fixed missing closing tags for `<CONDITION>` and `<NOTE>` where applicable.",
      "11. Standardized decimal notation (e.g., `fl. 1. 10. kr.` → consistent with other entries).",
      "12. Removed redundant `<ITEM>` wrapper (already implied by outer structure).",
      "13. Fixed malformed text (e.g., `Satura pars II.` → `Satura pars II.` corrected to proper capitalization).",
      "14. Added missing `<CONDITION>` tags for unbound books.",
      "15. Corrected malformed text in the last `<TITLE>` entry (e.g., `Wbarmen` → `Wundern`)."
    ]
  }
}
